references.text: A previous incident at Rephidim where the people lacked water and quarreled with Moses, showing a similar pattern of water shortage and complaining in the wilderness.
The immediate context telling of Miriam's death and the people's arrival at the Wilderness of Zin, where there was no water.
Korah's rebellion where the congregation also gathered against Moses and Aaron; the same expression וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ is used.
The Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron because of a lack of food in the wilderness, a similar pattern of rebellion.
The psalmist refers to this incident at the waters of Meribah where the people made Moses angry.
The Lord's reference to the waters of Meribah where the people contended with him, and Moses and Aaron did not honor God as holy.
Paul refers to the spiritual rock that followed the Israelites in the wilderness and gave them water.
